# Spinmfana
> Spinmfana is a free South African car-spinning (drift) arcade game that runs in any web browser on mobile or desktop. Drift iconic cars, chain combo degrees, spin for Rands and climb the leaderboard.

## What it is
- Genre: arcade drift / car-spinning game, inspired by South African spinning culture.
- Price: free. No download and no purchase — it runs in the browser.
- Platforms: web browser (mobile-first, also desktop).
- Origin: South Africa (ZA). Currency in-game is the Rand (R).

## How to play
- Hold throttle, steer into the slide, and tap the handbrake to keep the rear loose.
- Tight, continuous spins build combo degrees and raise your score multiplier.
- Cash out before your tyres wear out to bank your Rands.
- Buy faster cars and better tyres with the Rands you earn.

## Cars
- BMW E30 325i (starter), BMW E36 328i, Toyota Cressida 2.4i, Mazda RX-7 FC,
  BMW E46 M3, Toyota Supra 2JZ, Nissan Skyline GTR R34.

## Game modes
- Free Spin — open donut session; rack up combo degrees.
- Target Hunt — solo; spin around glowing rings for bonuses.
- Pass & Play — local hotseat for up to six players sharing one device (60s each).

## Key pages
- [Play](https://spinmfana.com/): start the game and open the garage.
- [Leaderboard](https://spinmfana.com/leaderboard): top scores ranked by Rands banked.
- [Pass & Play](https://spinmfana.com/passplay): local hotseat party mode.

## FAQ
- Is it free? Yes — completely free, browser-based, no download.
- Do I need an account? No. You can play as a guest; sign-in only adds your name to the leaderboard.
- What devices? Any modern mobile or desktop web browser.
